title: Socio-economic landscape of digital transformation & public NLP systems: A critical review
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark or measure any aspect of faith/religion. It is a critical review of the socio-economic landscape of NLP systems.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion or faith. Its focus is on the socio-economic, political, legal, security, and ethical impacts of NLP systems, with specific mentions of bias related to class and race, but not religion.
